d.ko: Fishing Inc is a cozy incremental fishing game! Catch fish, earn cash, and unlock powerful skills. Master new ponds, fill your Fish Log with Legendary catches, and become the ultimate angler!
d.en: Fishing Inc is a cozy incremental fishing game! Catch fish, earn cash, and unlock powerful skills. Master new ponds, fill your Fish Log with Legendary catches, and become the ultimate angler!
d.zh: Fishing Inc 是一款轻松惬意的增量钓鱼游戏！钓鱼、赚钱、解锁强大的技能。征服新的水域，用传说鱼类填满你的图册，成为终极钓鱼大师！
